points: Yirmiyahu blames the leaders, the shepherds: you can't expect the people to do right if the leaders themselves are doing wrong.
Hashem promises new shepherds: a "tzemach," a sprout of Dovid, the king Mashiach. A sprout grows everywhere, hinting that with Mashiach there will be many righteous people.
Mashiach is not just a savior but a person of tzedek and mishpat. That is the mark of a true Jewish leader.
False prophets in Hashem's name are worse than those who prophesied in the name of Baal. A rabbi who does bad things does more damage than a missionary.
He also criticizes people who share dreams and confusing messages, which make Torah look silly and degrade the word of Hashem.
